payout_value_note: $50 Visa eGift card per qualifying referral; maximum 11 referrals ($550) per calendar year
numeric_basis: payout from official terms ($50-$50 per referral); time: referral share est. 5-15 min active
steps: Advocate registers for the program and shares the referral offer with family and friends. Friend registers via the referral link, meets membership eligibility, opens a new membership with a deposit, loan, or credit card account, and the account stays open 60 days.
catches: Advocate must register for the program and share the offer. Only one advocate may receive a reward per qualifying friend. AdelFi may refuse to verify or process any transaction for any reason, including suspicion of fraud or abuse. The friend acknowledges the $50 Visa eGift card is sent to the advocate after all conditions are met. eGift card link via Tango email expires 4 months from email date; once redeemed, card must be used within 7 months. Visa is not a participant or sponsor.

eligibility: Friend: registers via the referral link, meets membership eligibility (affiliated with a Protestant Christian church/ministry/school or relative of a member), is 18+, no previous membership within past 180 days, opens a new membership with a deposit, loan, or credit card account that remains open for 60 days
timing: Processing begins after the friend's account has been open for 60 days; the $50 Visa eGift card is sent electronically to the advocate after all conditions are met.

when_cash_arrives: Processing begins after the friend's account has been open for 60 days; the $50 Visa eGift card is sent electronically to the advocate after all conditions are met. Terms impose a fixed waiting period after the friend's account opens - nothing arrives before that date.
maximize: Refer early and have your friend complete ALL qualifying activity in the first days of the window - late qualification pushes the fixed payout date even further out.
Both accounts must stay open and in good standing through the entire wait - early closure forfeits the bonus.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: the program's terms lock payout to a fixed date (60-120 days out) regardless of how fast your friend qualifies.
